title: snake3.xyz
tagline: Combining several access gating technologies in one. A B2B solution that allows DAPPs to implement all kind of gating mechanisms easier.
description:
The idea is to create an all-in-one gateway tool so that businesses (DAPPs) do not need to write code for the different gating mechanisms they want to include. Ultimately snake3.xyz would be a drag-and-drop tool for businesses. Meaning that with this tool, businesses will also be able to configure multiple requirements to access parts of their websites. 

This project combines several gating technologies, such as WorldCoin, (Nouns) NFTs, Soulbound, fungible tokens, and other potential gating systems.
how_its_made:
The tech Demo is using an existing DEX that we forked in the process of the creation. We amended front and backend integrations to include technologies from ETHGlobal Lisabon. 

Snake3.xyz is using Worldcoin to prove the user is a human being. It is using Airstack to check if you are holding a particular NFT or a threshold amount of tokens before you can enter the web app. It is using Metamask and its SKD to connect to the DAPP. The code is also deployed on Mantle, Scroll, Gnosis Chain, Polygon, ETH testnet, and allows the user to switch between all these networks in the UI.
